parameters.name: EnableOperation
parameters.description: Specifies whether to authorize the service provider to perform O\&M operations on the service instance.

parameters.name: ServiceInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the service instance.

You can call the [ListServiceInstances](~~396200~~) operation to obtain the ID of the service instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenest update-service-instance-attributes --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-instance-id si-d6ab3a63ccbb4b17xxxx --enable-operation true --granted-permission PolicyNames=example-string OperationEndTime=example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun computenest UpdateServiceInstanceAttributes --region cn-hangzhou --GrantedPermission.OperationEndTime 'example-string' --ServiceInstanceId 'si-d6ab3a63ccbb4b17xxxx' --GrantedPermission.PolicyNames 'example-string' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --EnableOperation true --method POST --force
